name: ReClip
author: Charles Gameti
description: Keyboard-driven clipboard manager for Omarchy: searchable history, snippets and a paste queue, plus an image editor, color studio, text transformers and diff, OCR, QR scanning and generation, and Wi-Fi file sharing. Skips password managers.

barWidget.description: Clipboard history, snippets, paste queue, image editor, color studio, OCR, QR scanning/generation, and Wi-Fi file sharing
